description: Central Bank Of Sri Lanka - Debt Recovery( Special Provisions ) Act Notification Under Section 30
categorisation: The gazette content is a notification by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, issued under the authority of the *Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act*. It formally announces a regulatory determination (the new Market Rate of Interest) that has legal force. The core of the notice is the establishment of a specific financial regulation, making it a matter of legal and regulatory framework. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized category like Land, Commercial, or Elections. Therefore, it is classified as a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
